name: Reconstruct 3D Face From Mri
description: Generate a 3D model of facial anatomy from MRI scans of the head and neck.
detailed_description: Generate a 3D model of facial anatomy from MRI scans of the head and neck.
when_to_use: When you need reconstruct 3d face from mri analysis

parameters.mri_file_path: [Required] Path to the MRI scan file (NIfTI format: .nii or .nii.gz) (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Optional] Directory where output files will be saved (default: ./output)
parameters.subject_id: [Optional] Identifier for the subject, used in output filenames (default: subject)
parameters.threshold_value: [Optional] Threshold value for initial segmentation of facial tissues (default: 300)
